name: Model Sense public rate history (U.S. Treasury CMT)

provenance.source_workbook: PUBLIC UST DATA: U.S. Treasury constant-maturity par yields (H.15) retrieved from FRED (DGS1MO, DGS3MO, DGS6MO, DGS1, DGS2, DGS3, DGS5, DGS7, DGS10, DGS20, DGS30), month-end, 2008-10 through 2026-03; daily cache research/data/public/fred_dgs_cmt_2008-10-01_2026-03-31.csv. Plus a CONSTRUCTED term-funding spread (see term_funding_note). No licensed series, no EFFR, no SOFR, no FOMC target range.
provenance.sofr_note: Treasury CMT par yields read generically as the risk-free benchmark curve. Never a SOFR quote and never to be relabelled as one. Tenors 48, 72, 96, 108, 180 and 300 months are not published by Treasury and are interpolated linearly in maturity between the neighbouring published points (owner ruling R2, research/data/public/PUBLIC-RATE-HISTORY-BUILD_v1.md). The short anchor is the published 1-month bill CMT point, not an overnight rate.
provenance.term_funding_note: CONSTRUCTED term-funding rates: the public benchmark curve plus a hand-specified round-number spread schedule, the same schedule research/gen_constructed_rate_history.py discloses. A generic stand-in for an institution's wholesale term-funding curve; not offered levels and not market data.
